description:
Signed conditional-release verdict — are the release conditions met? (PAID $0.25)

VALUE: A settlement that releases only if its named conditions hold — escrow logic as a single call.

PRICE: $0.25 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.

as_of.description: The evaluation instant, ISO-8601. Pinned into the evidence core so the digest is reproducible.
as_of.title: As Of

conditions.description: The conditions to evaluate. An empty list yields verdict 'hold' — never 'release'.

items.description:
One release condition. `type` selects the evaluator; the rest of the
fields are read by that evaluator only.

after.description: time_elapsed: the ISO-8601 instant the condition becomes true.
after.title: After

artifact.description: artifact_hash / output_verified: the payload to hash or verify.
artifact.title: Artifact

as_of.description: time_elapsed: the ISO-8601 evaluation instant. Supply it for a byte-identical digest across runs.
as_of.title: As Of

asset.description: receipt_verified: 'USDC' or the USDC address. Anything else is a coverage gap, not a verdict.
asset.title: Asset

attestation_id.description: attestation_present: the attestation id to look for.
attestation_id.title: Attestation Id

claims.description: output_verified: the claims to check the artifact against.
claims.title: Claims

expected_amount_atomic.description: receipt_verified: the required amount in atomic USDC units.
expected_amount_atomic.title: Expected Amount Atomic

expected_sha256.description: artifact_hash: the expected sha256 hex digest.
expected_sha256.title: Expected Sha256

observed_sha256.description: artifact_hash: the observed sha256 hex digest. If absent and an `artifact` is supplied, the digest is recomputed from it.
observed_sha256.title: Observed Sha256

payer.description: receipt_verified: the expected payer address. When both payer and payee are supplied, the service's own settlement rule set is run and must say SETTLED.
payer.title: Payer

subject.description: output_verified: what the artifact is about.
subject.title: Subject

tx_hash.description: receipt_verified: the transaction hash to read.
tx_hash.title: Tx Hash

type.description: One of: artifact_hash | receipt_verified | output_verified | time_elapsed | attestation_present. An unsupported type is INDETERMINATE with the supported vocabulary named.
